Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday

Germantown, TN · Road

No-drop

Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday is a road group ride in Germantown, TN. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Trek Bicycle Germantown (parking lot north of the tennis courts). About 20–28 miles, b/C/D groups. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: b/C/D groups. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Major Taylor Thirsty Thursday group ride

Thursday evening no-drop ride in Germantown, run under the Hightailers' Major Taylor banner. Twenty to twenty-eight miles in B, C and D groups. Seasonal, spring through September.
